Since we get xml data in Splunk, we'll organize them in columns or searchable fields,it will help us to create dashboards.We'll install Spluk Add-on for Microsoft Windows for that. Instead, you may also extract fields by using delimiter and regex.

Open Splunk Enterprise home (not search page)> click on find more apps at the top left > search for microsoft windows > There you'll find Splunk Add-on for Microsoft Windows as a search result. 

To download it, you'll need your original splunk.com account not your Enterprise user/pw. After installation you'll find the app under Manage in splunk home. Remember you can install it from splunkbase.splunk.com also, the official page for splunk downloads. 

Then running search again still shows xml data, not columned data. The issue is that the Sysmon logs were already indexed before installing the add-on as raw XML. The add-on only processes new incoming logs going forward. To fix it, we'll clean up existing indexed data, generate logs and then search again. 

Let's delete now by writing in search field: 

```
index="main" sourcetype="XmlWinEventLog:Microsoft-Windows-Sysmon/Operational" | delete
```

it gives me an error like insufficient privilege, so let's open settings > roles > give can_delete permission. Then logout & login & try deleting them. It worked.

**![](data:image/png;base64,)
<center>Now we see interesting fields as columns</center>

To display desired fields (as per Splunk, Interesting Fields) as columns you need to use table keyword like:  
  
```
index=main sourcetype=XmlWinEventLog  | table _time host EventCode CommandLine Hashes
```

**![](data:image/png;base64,)**
<center>We got what we wanted</center>
